result.question: Qual percentual de internacoes possui diagnostico secundario preenchido por ano e por desfecho?
result.gold_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "DIAG_SECUN" IS NOT NULL AND "DIAG_SECUN" <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS com_diag_secundario FROM internacoes WHERE "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano, desfecho) SELECT ano, desfecho, total_internacoes, com_diag_secundario, ROUND(com_diag_secundario * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS percentual_com_diag_secundario FROM agg ORDER BY ano, desfecho;
result.generated_sql: SELECT ano, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "DIAG_SECUN" IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS proporcao FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, "DIAG_SECUN", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ORDER BY "DT_INTER") AS rn FROM internacoes ) sub GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;
